def.what: The hub control record for one protected application.
def.creator: The DR administrator enrolls the application.
def.reader: Ramen on the hub and the ACM console.
def.analogy: A job ticket that records the requested move and how far it got.

card.name: dr-policy-15m
card.role: pairs the sites and sets the 900-second objective

def.what: The rule that pairs two clusters and sets the recovery point objective.
def.creator: The DR administrator creates it on the hub.
def.reader: Ramen and the console read it.
def.analogy: A promise about how much data may be lost, not a timer.

card.name: hammerdb-win-drpc
card.role: coordinates all protected disks on one cluster

def.what: The per-cluster coordinator for a group of protected disks.
def.creator: Ramen delivers it from the hub.
def.analogy: A foreman who tracks every disk job on one site.

card.name: hammerdb-win-datadisk
card.role: asks the driver to replicate or change one disk role

def.what: The work order for one protected disk.
def.creator: The VRG creates one per protected claim.
def.reader: csi-addons translates it into Dell driver calls.
def.analogy: A separate work order for each disk.

card.name: powerstore-vrc-15m
card.role: selects the driver and the fifteen-minute schedule

def.what: The settings for replicating a disk.
def.creator: The storage administrator creates it.
def.analogy: The delivery contract for the recovery copy.

card.name: hammerdb-win-datadisk
card.role: the source claim whose deletion is blocked

def.what: A request for storage, here one VM disk.
def.creator: The DataVolume creates it.
def.reader: The VM uses it, and controllers add finalizers.
def.where: hammerdb-win on the old source, spoke-0.
def.analogy: A claim ticket that cannot be thrown away while someone still holds a lock on it.

card.name: csi-addons + Dell CSM
card.role: turns replication requests into PowerStore calls

def.what: The two controllers that execute storage replication.
def.creator: The platform installs them on each spoke.
def.where: csi-addons and csi-powerstore pods on each spoke.
def.analogy: The translator between Kubernetes and the storage array.

card.name: 12aa0804-be9a-47a7-b1a8-2cf36bb240b1
card.role: one PowerStore copy relationship between the arrays

def.what: One replication relationship inside the storage array.
def.creator: The Dell driver creates it when replication is enabled.
def.reader: The driver and the array act on it.
def.analogy: A two-way pipe that can carry data in one direction at a time.

define.text: The session has a new direction but no reverse copy yet. Reprotect and resync must run before the old site is a standby again.
